title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Access restriction bypass for form submissions in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4,…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1 allows bypassing access restrictions on form submissions. This flaw enables unauthenticated users (guests) to submit forms that are intended to be restricted to specific user groups.
